A LITTLE LESS FRICTION

Get back to reading.

Setup, the few controls that matter, and what to try when a page does not cooperate.

First time here?

Start in the reading lab without an install, or follow the developer beta instructions. The Chrome Web Store release is pending.

How do I use Skim after installing it?

Pin Skim from Chrome’s puzzle-piece extensions menu. Open an article or a long AI answer, click Skim, and start Pointer mode. Move back into the page and pause over a paragraph. Choose a reading goal in the small dock.

To keep using it on that website, open the popup and choose Remember on this site. Chrome asks for access to that site. Once approved, the dock can return on later visits.

What do pause, close, and forget do?

Pause stops sentence highlighting without removing the dock. Close or Escape removes the lens from this page. A remembered site can start again after navigation. To keep it off across visits, forget the site in settings. Global pause in settings stops automatic use across all remembered sites until you resume it.

Why does it ask for permission on a site?

Automatic activation requires ongoing access to that site. One-off use works from your click without enabling every website. If you decline the prompt, you can continue one-off use. If your administrator restricts extensions, you may need their approval.

Nothing highlights, or the dock is missing.

Try an ordinary article page, start Pointer mode, and linger on a full paragraph. Make sure Skim is not globally paused. Chrome blocks extension scripts on its settings pages and the Chrome Web Store. PDFs, embedded frames, shadow-root content, very short paragraphs, and unusual layouts may not work. Reload the page after an extension update if an old dock remains.

As a fallback, select a paragraph and use Open page in Skim. The extension reader keeps that text local.

Does this work inside ChatGPT?

The on-page pointer lens works with normal rendered paragraphs and lists. Reader import tries the latest rendered assistant answer, or your text selection if you made one. ChatGPT’s markup can change, and every view has not been tested. Selecting the exact passage first is the most predictable import path.

Skim is an independent project and is not an official OpenAI or ChatGPT extension.

Is it tracking my eyes or running over every Mac app?

The extension uses your pointer. The webcam lab is separate and requires explicit consent, calibration, and a quality check. This release does not track your eyes over arbitrary websites, run over macOS apps, or provide a native Mac notch widget.

You can check whether this browser can start webcam mode before giving camera permission.

Can I undo what it changes?

The on-page lens uses browser highlights and does not wrap or rewrite the original text. Close the dock to remove the highlight. If a website and the dock conflict, refresh the tab or disable Skim for that site. Settings let you remove remembered sites and reset preferences.

How do updates work?

The current unpacked beta needs manual updates. Download the new ZIP, replace the extracted files, then click Reload on Skim in chrome://extensions. A future approved Chrome Web Store install will receive updates through Chrome. Store updates can still require review before users receive them.

Do I need Jev, an API key, or a paid account?

No. The extension and hosted lab choose sentences locally. The source includes an optional Jev integration for developers running the localhost server. It is off by default and separate from the extension.

How do I remove Skim and its data?

Open chrome://extensions, find Skim Reading Lens, and click Remove. This clears the extension’s local preferences. Close any reader tabs. If you separately enabled the hosted gaze lab, revoke its camera permission in browser site settings.

Found a rough edge?

A useful report explains what you expected, what happened, and how to repeat it. The button below creates a plain-text template on your device. Nothing is sent automatically.

Open a GitHub issue or email your report to the support address below. Remove private page text, URLs, names, and screenshots before sharing. Email security and privacy reports privately.

Want to improve it?

Clone the GitHub repository or download the complete source. It includes tests, contribution instructions, known limitations, and release scripts. No build dependencies are needed to run the core app with Node.js 20 or newer.
